name: Golden Mango
commentary:
Courier consumable: Activated when taking fatal damage
Consumes 1 charge of Golden Enchanted Mango and protects your Courier from fatal damage for this round.

The round is still counted as a loss.

source.name: Golden Mango
source.description: A special mango reward Mango Tree can drop if it is still alive when the relic expires.
